result.summary: docs/agents/design/REQ-005.md gated PASS. Read the design artefact independently (not CODE-DESIGNER's summary). All 5 checks passed: (1) every acceptance criterion maps to a concrete design element via §6's table, §5 states 'Open questions: None', no TBD/deferral language found anywhere in §1-§4. (2) §1 explicitly states 'No new component. No new prop.' -- not silently skipped. (3) No implementation code present -- reviewed full doc, §2/§3 contain only structural-shape/content-shape listings and a file tree, no .tsx/.ts code blocks. (4) Independently re-read src/i18n/request.ts, src/components/landing/LocaleSwitcher.tsx, and src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx myself: all three are confirmed fully generic over routing.locales with zero hardcoded locale literals (request.ts loads `messages/${locale}.json` dynamically; LocaleSwitcher.tsx maps routing.locales.map(...); layout.tsx uses hasLocale(routing.locales, locale) and reads the Metadata namespace via getTranslations) -- matches the design doc's quoted claims exactly, and also confirmed src/i18n/routing.ts's current baseline is exactly ["ru","uz","en"] as the design doc states. (5) Confirmed Metadata.ogLocale='ru_RU' is stated in §3/§5 as a literal value taken directly from the requirement text, explicitly contrasted with REQ-003's inferred/open en_US case -- correctly settled, not an open question. Also spot-checked token references (var(--primary), var(--muted), var(--border)) against docs/Design system for AI agents/tokens/tokens.css and confirmed all three resolve to real token definitions (light and dark).
